status: DD-ME2 AND TW99 COUPLING TABLES EXTRACTED FROM ORIGINAL PAPER PDFs AND SOLVER-VERIFIED; NL3/TM1/FSU2/FSU2H CONFIRMED AS NONLINEAR WALECKA MODELS REQUIRING SOLVER EXTENSION (BLOCKED)
node: M3-l (GPPVA model coupling extraction from original-paper PDFs + functional-form correction)
summary: Inspected the 7 GPPVA models in the JSON. Found that GPPVA_DD2 was already extracted (M3-earlier), GPPVA_DDME2 and GPPVA_TW had PLACEHOLDER couplings (wrong values + wrong functional-form note), and GPPVA_FSU2/FSU2H/NL3wrL55/TM1e all had PLACEHOLDER dummy values with functional_form incorrectly set to DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL. Extracted exact coupling tables for DD-ME2 (from Lalazissis 2005 PRC 71 024312 Table I, in upload/lalazissis2005.pdf) and TW99 (from Typel 1999 NPA 656 331 Table 1, in upload/typel1999.pdf). Both use the same DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL functional form (rational for sigma/omega + exp for rho), confirming the prior 'TW99 uses a+b*exp form' note was a misread. For TW99, identified that the published g_rho(rho_sat) = 7.32196 must be HALVED to 3.66098 because Typel 1999 uses a 1/2 isospin factor in the rho-meson Lagrangian (our solver follows Lalazissis 2005 convention with no 1/2 factor). Without this conversion, J_sym = 73.4 MeV (non-physical); with it, J_sym = 32.77 MeV (target 32.8) - excellent agreement. For NL3/TM1/FSU2/FSU2H, identified that these are NONLINEAR WALECKA models (constant couplings + sigma^3, sigma^4 self-interaction + omega-rho cross-coupling Lambda_v), NOT density-dependent DD2 forms - the prior functional_form='DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL' for all 4 was incorrect and has been corrected to 'NL3_WALECKA_NONLINEAR'. Our rmf_solver currently only supports DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL and SPG_GOGELEIN; the NL3_WALECKA_NONLINEAR form must be added to the solver before these 4 models can be processed. Their PLACEHOLDER coupling values remain dummy stand-ins pending (a) the solver extension and (b) exact coupling extraction from Chen-Piekarewicz 2014 (FSU2), Negreiros 2018 (FSU2H), Pais-Providencia 2016 (NL3wrL55), and Sugahara-Toki 1994 / arXiv:2001.10143 (TM1e).

GPPVA_FSU2.model_description: FSU2 is a NONLINEAR WALECKA model: constant meson-nucleon couplings (g_sigma, g_omega, g_rho) + sigma self-interaction (kappa, lambda for sigma^3, sigma^4) + omega-rho cross-coupling (Lambda_v). The DD2 density-dependent rational form does not apply.

key_findings.isospin_convention_difference: Typel 1999 uses g_rho/2 * tau.rho in the rho-meson Lagrangian; Lalazissis 2005 (and our solver) uses g_rho * tau.rho without the 1/2 factor. This factor-2 difference is critical: applying the published TW99 g_rho = 7.32196 directly gives J_sym = 73.4 MeV (non-physical); halving to 3.66098 gives J_sym = 32.77 MeV (target 32.8). This resolves the prior PLACEHOLDER note that misread TW99 as using a 'a+b*exp' functional form - the real issue was a convention mismatch in the isovector sector, not the functional form.
key_findings.functional_form_mislabeling: The prior JSON had GPPVA_FSU2/FSU2H/NL3wrL55/TM1e all labeled functional_form='DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL', but these are actually NONLINEAR WALECKA models (constant couplings + sigma^3/sigma^4 + omega-rho cross-coupling). This mislabeling would have produced wrong physics if the reconstruction had been attempted. Corrected to NL3_WALECKA_NONLINEAR and marked BLOCKED until the solver is extended.
key_findings.ddme2_tw99_share_dd2_form: Both DD-ME2 (Lalazissis 2005) and TW99 (Typel 1999) use the SAME functional form as DD2 (rational for sigma/omega + exp for rho), confirming the DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL label is correct for these two. The 5-parameter density dependence (a, b, c, d for sigma/omega + a for rho) is universal across the DD-ME family.
